What is this business about putting an object down and now it's painted with colors he never used elsewhere? Did he prepaint onto those magazine pages?

Nope, he's only using the few colors. You're probably thinking about how he does the texture. It's a technique I've seen with a lot of these artists. They use the wrinkles on the magazine to give a texture to the fresh paint on the canvas. Painting works on layers and he's simply removing the upper layers to expose the lower layers. They push the wrinkles in, lift the paint a bit and then remove the magazine. and create an impression of the texture.

If you watch closely, you can see him setting up the lower layers and then working to put more layers on it. With the moon, he puts on the paints, gives it a texture then covers it. He then paints around the lid and when he removes it, the paint he sprayed around it is the upper layer, giving it the round shape of a moon.
